## PRX Pre-Match Scouting Summary

**Roster Composition:** 2 Duelists, 1 Controller, 1 Initiator, 1 Sentinel. Three players (Jinggg, f0rsakeN, d4v41) are flagged as flex.

---

**Firepower**

Something leads the team at 230 ACS / 1.19 rating, playing Jett in nearly two-thirds of his games. He is the primary duelist and the team's top fragger by a clear margin. Jinggg sits just behind at 223 ACS / 1.10 rating, anchored on Raze (56%).

What's worth flagging: d4v41 (201 ACS, 1.03 rating) and f0rsakeN (200 ACS, 0.96 rating) are close in output to each other, and invy — the lone initiator — matches Jinggg's 1.10 rating despite the lowest ACS on the roster (197). The team's firepower is relatively compressed from positions 2 through 5; something is the clear outlier at the top.

---

**Flex Roles**

f0rsakeN is listed as the controller but splits nearly a quarter of his games on Neon, with additional time on Skye and Astra. He is not a pure smoker specialist. Similarly, d4v41's sentinel role spreads across Viper, Vyse, and Killjoy with no dominant single pick — genuine flex. Jinggg plays Omen and Phoenix alongside Raze, adding controller capacity from the duelist slot.

---

**Specialists**

Something and invy show the clearest role lock-in. Something stays on Jett the large majority of the time. Invy distributes across four initiators (Sova, Skye, Breach, Fade) but does not flex outside the initiator class.

---

**No limited-data flags** on any player in this window.
